title: What a Godly Man Does While He's Single (It's Not Waiting)
caption:
Single is not a waiting room. It's where God builds the man she'd be marrying.

Quit auditioning, get useful, plant yourself in real men, and chase God first. Send this to a brother who's tired of waiting.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #single #discipline
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
